offering_description.value: Supplies electricity and natural gas to residential, commercial and industrial customers through regulated utilities in the northwestern United States and Alaska.

primary_services.value: electric transmission and distribution; natural gas distribution

customer_segment.value: B2C: Residential electricity and natural gas customers; B2B: Commercial and industrial energy users, wholesale energy counterparties; B2G: Government facilities and public institutions within utility service territories
